responses.text: Heh, so the Garrets sent you to track me down? What a joke.
{Cold} Be quick and quiet, and don't get dead.
{Annoyed} Do I look like a career counselor, kid? Get lost.

topics.prompt: Any bounty hunting tips for me?

responses.text: {Irritated} You've got a mouth on you, kid. If I weren't busy working for the Garrets, I might give you a few lessons in common courtesy. Get lost.

topics.prompt: I'm not a kid, old man.

responses.text: {Tired and unamused} I'd rather not waste the ammo, kid. But, if you insist, draw.

topics.prompt: I'm here to collect, McCaffery. No one crosses the Garret Twins.

responses.text: {Annoyed} Now why the hell should I do that? You're below me, kid.
{Cold, Deadly serious} I've been killing scum twice your size since before your mother squeezed you out.

topics.prompt: Give me a share of the caps and your hat and you can go free.
Nah, just thought I'd say hi.

responses.text: {Cold, snickering} If you think you've got the guts, I'd like to see you try.

topics.prompt: I guess I haven't got a choice but to put you away.

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] {Amused} Well, that sounds like a bit of a bargain. I get to walk free with the Garrets thinking I'm dead.
{Amused} Sure, you can have my hat. I can always buy another with the caps I've got left.
{Friendly} It would have been more fun fighting it out, though. See you later, kid.

topics.prompt: All I need is your hat, and you're a free man. I'll tell Francine you're dead.
topics.label: <Speech>

responses.text: [FAILED] <Glare> {Deadly serious} Better get your ass moving before your mouth gets you into trouble, kid.

topics.prompt: Hand over your hat before I pump you full of hot lead, you old fart!

responses.text: {Cold} Hunting and killing, plain and simple.

topics.prompt: What do you do around here?

responses.text: {Irritated} Bingo. Now if you're done asking stupid questions, I have more important things to do.
Piss off, kid. We've got no more business to conduct.
